title: The Queen Is Only Energy
summary: Gu He and his group arrive at the shrine during the ceremony and demand to see Queen Medusa. When she appears he offers two Sixth-Tier Fighting Spirit Pills and a Seventh-Tier Body Transformation Pill for the Green Lotus Core Flame. Medusa refuses, and Gu He reveals that the figure before them is only a body of energy holding a touch of her mind. Ms. Yun strikes, the energy body breaks, and the Snakemen think their queen is dead and attack. The Snakemen light the Summoning Order to call the leaders of the Eight Large Tribes. Hua She Er unmasks the disguised Xiao Yan and chases him with Art of Snake, Rampage, at peak Dou Wang strength. He escapes into a trapped hall with rune tiles, where Yao Lao senses the Heavenly Flame right below them.
